faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Archive Manager post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Archive Manager – TRIBAL Project post at IIT Jammu is 30 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Archive Manager position?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduation or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Information Technology, or a related field to be eligible for the Archive Manager post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Archive Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Archive Manager position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Archive Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Archive Manager – TRIBAL Project post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Archive Manager post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Archive Manager – TRIBAL Project position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Archive Manager post at IIT Jammu will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the IIT Jammu Archive Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Archive Manager – TRIBAL Project post is entirely online through the official IIT Jammu website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for the IIT Jammu Archive Manager – TRIBAL Project recruitment is IITJMU/R&C/RP-100382/A-34.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Archive Manager position?
faq.answer: The Archive Manager – TRIBAL Project position at IIT Jammu is a contractual role.
